questions.question: What sin did Ezra learn the people had committed?
options: Worship of the idols of Babylon
Theft from the sacred treasury of the temple

questions.question: How did Ezra react when he heard this?
options: He fled away from the city and hid himself for many days
He rejoiced greatly that the exiles had finally returned
He tore his garment, pulled hair, and sat appalled
He ignored the troubling report and said nothing at all
questions.answer: He tore his garment, pulled hair, and sat appalled

questions.question: Ezra prayed, confessing the people's guilt and acknowledging God's grace in leaving a remnant.
Ezra said he was too ashamed to lift his _____ to God because of their iniquities.
Ezra fell on his knees and spread out his _____ to the LORD his God.
